items.title: Bill Ackman Unveils Six New Stock Picks
items.summary: Bill Ackman’s Pershing Square made investments in six new public companies since the end of March:  Visa   Mastercard   Netflix   S&P Global   Intercontinental Exchange   Alcon   The additions were disclosed in a letter to shareholders that accompanied Pershing Square’s quarterly earnings release, the firm’s first since it went public in April.

items.title: Visa (V) Broadens Stablecoin Settlement Capabilities
items.summary: Visa (NYSE:V) is expanding its stablecoin settlement capabilities through new partnerships with Lightspark and Zerohash. The partnerships focus on using USDC and other stablecoins for settlement and payout solutions across Visa's client and partner network. Visa aims to support programmable payments, faster cross-border transactions, and onchain disbursements through these integrations.
